problem_type: process-name based UX walk startup deadlock
symptom: Full-walk scripts waited up to 30 minutes whenever any nomi.exe or electron.exe existed, including the user's installed app and an unkillable zombie.
direct_cause: The full-walk launcher counted machine-wide process names instead of instances started by the walk harness.
class_root: The launch lifecycle had no shared ownership registry connecting a spawned Electron PID to its worktree and teardown.
affected_population: Users with the installed Nomi app open
Machines with an unrelated or zombie electron.exe
Concurrent full-walk runs from another worktree
internal_only_reason: The ownership invariant is internal to the test harness; no third-party behavior decides which process the harness may wait for.
invariants: Only a PID registered by the shared walk launcher for the same worktree can delay a full-walk startup.
Every registered PID is removed on process exit, normal close, failed startup, timeout, or stale-process discovery.
generality_proof: All UX Electron launches converge on launchNomiApp, and full-walk startup reads the same registry through readLiveWalkInstances; unrelated processes have no registry record and cannot enter the wait set.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own PID registration and idempotent lifecycle cleanup.
Filter by worktree, test liveness, and delete stale records.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Every shared UX launcher now registers its Electron child through the common helper.
The wait reads only live same-worktree records and no longer invokes tasklist or ps.

recurrence.reason: Any future launcher or process-name variant could reproduce the deadlock without an ownership boundary.

prevention.invariant: Wait sets contain only live registered PIDs belonging to the requested worktree.
prevention.failure_mode: Malformed and dead records are removed; unregistered processes are ignored.
prevention.strategy: Converge registration and liveness filtering in one helper used by both launchers.

legacy_paths.rationale: 旧的 tasklist/ps 进程名扫描是在 tests/ux/full-walk/launch.mjs 原地替换的，没有并行旧文件或迁移路径。

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls the registry invariant.

migration: No persisted user data is changed; stale registry JSON is safely discarded on read.
residual_risks: A process PID reused after an unexpectedly abandoned registry file cannot be distinguished without platform-specific creation-time APIs; stale liveness cleanup still bounds the record lifetime.

door_reduction.why_not: 登记写入与登记读取是两个共享边界；启动和等待分别需要各自的入口，不能合并成一扇门。

invariant_owner_layer.why: 共享助手是唯一负责登记、存活过滤和残留清理的边界，两个启动器只调用它；测试直接覆盖该边界的四类等待判定。
